limitations: Success duration percentiles use only naturally victorious members of each strategy/layout group; deaths and unresolved outcomes never enter that timing denominator.
TTK means describe defeated entities only, include approach time, and censor enemies still alive at the end. Histogram rank buckets are not exact median lifetimes. Fusion donors are not kills.
Campaign elite count is zero: missing applicability is shown as null, not invented zero TTK.
The per-run maximum one-second HP-loss window excludes sacrifice self-cost and does not prove physical-device experience.
